entries.query_str: ran a half yesterday (1:24:51, pr). quads wrecked. when can i run again and should i do easy runs or rest
entries.answer:
Congrats on the PR. Typical guidance [1][2]:
- **Days 1–3**: rest or very light cross-training (easy spin, walking). Quad soreness (DOMS) usually peaks 24–72 h after racing, especially with downhills.
- **Days 3–7**: short easy runs (20–40 min) at a truly easy effort once you can run without altered gait.
- **Week 2**: back to normal aerobic volume; hold off on hard workouts until about **7–10 days** after a half [2].
A rough rule some coaches use is one easy day per mile raced before the next hard session — about 13 days for a half [1].
